vedic_reference.note: Kshetraj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kshetra' which means 'field' or 'area'. The name Kshetraj is a compound of 'Kshetra' and 'Ja' which means 'lord' or 'master'. Kshetraj is often considered to be a form of Lord Vishnu, who is the protector and maintainer of the universe.
